rex-fleet-academy.text: Rex Fleet Academy — professional Fleet education for pilots, navigators, technicians, mechanics, junior officers and statesmen. Mature Fleet visual grammar is blue, gold and Ion White: authority and stewardship rather than dependency on the corridors.

fleet-survey-service.text: Fleet Survey Service — navigators, pilots, technicians and field researchers who maintain, verify and extend safe route knowledge beyond the Core. Survey craft favor practical markings, instrument visibility and restrained Fleet heraldry.
